name: Breloom
description: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.

moves.name: Mach Punch
moves.description: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Feint
moves.description: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Force Palm
moves.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.description: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Low Sweep
moves.description: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Pounce
moves.description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
